snippet.title: Mech Encounter - Rise of the Blade | Indie Game Full Walkthrough
snippet.description:
shrinedynamics.itch.io/mech-encounter-rise-of-the-blade
Mech Encounter: Rise of the Blade is an action mech combat simulation inspired by Mechwarrior 2 and other classic games of the era.
Mech Encounter: Rise of the Blade was made by myself - Shrine Dynamics - in two weeks for MechJam III and received 4th place overall.
